messages:
Emma (SRE): paging: noticed 3xx increase in inference latency from us-east-1 pool ~09:12 UTC. Customers hitting timeouts. I'm going to open an incident.
OpsBot: Incident created: INC-2026-042 (latency spike: us-east-1 inference pool). Severity: S2. Pageresponder: @Maya (Oncall).
Maya (Oncall): On it. Starting triage. Can someone drop a quick customer-facing line we can post to status page?
Raj (Support): For Zendesk/Intercom we should have a short acknowledgement macro. Draft: "Thanks — we’re aware of increased latency in US‑East impacting responses. Our engineers are investigating; we’ll follow up with another update within 30 minutes." Thoughts?
Lisa (CS): Good start. Add MD link to status page and a PSA about retries: "If you see timeouts, please retry; we're prioritizing live requests." Also include contact for escalations (account team).
Emma (SRE): Putting a slightly more technical variant for status page: 
```
Current: Elevated latency observed in our US-East inference pool affecting request latency and causing timeouts for some customers. Engineers are investigating root cause; retries and automatic fallback to regional replicas are enabled.
Impact: Increased tail latency, intermittent timeouts for text generation endpoints.
Mitigation: Autoscaling and routing policies adjusted to shift traffic; engineers continuing rollback of a recent kernel patch.
Next update: 30 minutes or sooner.
```
Maya (Oncall): Nice. Can we also create a short Intercom/Zendesk macro that support can paste? Prefer < 2 lines. How about: "Hi — we're seeing higher-than-normal latency for requests in US‑East. Our engineers are working on it; please retry. We'll update within 30 minutes."
Raj (Support): I'll refine macros. Proposed Zendesk macro (copyable): 
```
We're aware of increased latency in US‑East impacting inference responses. Our engineering team is actively investigating. Please retry requests; if you continue to see issues, reply to this ticket with the request ID and a short sample. We’ll update you within 30 minutes.
```
Lisa (CS): Add an opt‑out for customers on Dedicated: "Dedicated customers: if you want us to move your traffic to a different region, reply and we’ll coordinate."
Ben (Product): Add a line about model fallbacks so customers understand behavior: "If a model fallback occurred, you may see slight changes in output — we'll surface any quality regressions."
Emma (SRE): Good. Also we need an internal troubleshooting checklist for support & oncall to triage incoming tickets quickly. Draft checklist: 
1) Capture request_id, timestamp, region
2) Check status.redwood.ai for incident status and last update
3) Confirm if customer is on Dedicated/Private or Hosted
4) If Hosted: look up routing logs for that request_id, check node latencies
5) If Dedicated: escalate to Solutions Eng + Open private control plane logs
6) If timeouts: recommend client-side retry (exponential backoff) and increase timeout window temporarily
7) If customer reports quality regression, flag to Research + Eval team

Maya (Oncall): I'll post the status page update and pin the checklist in the incident channel. Raj — can you create two macros? One short (Intercom ephemeral), one longer (Zendesk detailed) and include placeholders for {{request_id}} and {{region}}.
Raj (Support): On it. Draft Intercom quick reply (one-line): 
```
We’re investigating increased latency in US‑East. Please retry and share your request ID if the issue persists — we’ll follow up within 30 minutes.
```
Zendesk detailed macro with placeholders: 
```
We’re aware of increased latency in {{region}} affecting inference responses. Our engineers are investigating. Please retry your request with exponential backoff. If you continue to experience issues, reply with the following:
- request_id: {{request_id}}
- approximate timestamp: {{timestamp}}
- model/endpoint used: {{model}}

If you are on a Dedicated deployment and need immediate rerouting, indicate that here and we’ll connect you with your Solutions Eng.
```
Lisa (CS): Add standard sign-off for SLA-sensitive customers: "If this impacts your SLA, mark the ticket as urgent and cc your account rep."
Emma (SRE): We should also include an internal message template for rotation/handoff so next oncall can pick up easily. Handoff template: 
```
INC-2026-042 summary:
- Started: 09:12 UTC
- Impact: Elevated tail latency in us-east inference pool; timeouts for some requests.
- Actions taken: scaled additional workers, disabled recent kernel patch on canary, adjusted routing to favor replicas in other regions.
- Open work: root cause analysis of kernel patch; watch for regressions.
- Key contacts: Maya (oncall), Emma (SRE), Raj (Support), Lisa (CS), Ben (Product)
- Next update expected by: 09:42 UTC
```
Maya (Oncall): Perfect. I’ll paste that into the handoff DM when my shift ends. Can someone add the Zendesk macro to the Support macros repo?
Raj (Support): Added to support/macros repo and pasted as a snippet in this thread.
Emma (SRE): Quick note for postmortem: record timeline and metric deltas (p95/p99, request rate) and note that a kernel patch rollback mitigated latency.
Ben (Product): We should also prepare a short external customer notification email template for account teams to send to sensitive customers. Draft: 
```
Subject: Incident affecting inference latency in US‑East — update
Body:
Hi {{customer_name}},
We wanted to let you know we’re investigating elevated latency in our US‑East inference pool which may have affected recent requests. Our engineers are actively working to mitigate the issue; we’ve rolled back a recent change and traffic is being routed away from impacted nodes.
We’ll provide another update within 1 hour. If you have questions or require immediate rerouting, reply to this email and we’ll prioritize your request.
Best,
Redwood Inference Ops
```
Lisa (CS): That’s good. Makes it easy for AMs to send.
Maya (Oncall): Update posted to status.redwood.ai and pinned here. Intercom quick macro live in composer. Zendesk macro added to our macros repo. I’m handing off to Emma for next watch at 09:50 UTC.
Emma (SRE): Taking watch. Thanks all. I’ll monitor replication metrics and push a postmortem template once RCA is clearer. :thumbsup:
